description: Many implementations conflate “I cannot currently validate this block due to missing local prerequisites” with “this block is permanently invalid by consensus rules.” If the system persists/caches the latter conclusion (bad-block DB, reject cache, peer penalization), then once the missing state is restored the node still refuses the canonical block. This yields permanent sync stalls and/or long-lived divergence that survives restarts.
fault_type: crash_recovery / storage_corruption / sync_gap (local transient prerequisite missing)
trigger_condition: - A node imports/validates a block whose execution requires specific state trie nodes (account/storage paths) that are temporarily unavailable locally (MissingNode, pruned snapshot gap, incomplete state sync).
